description: Golden dataset for the customer support email classifier. Hand-labeled test cases across billing, technical, account, and general categories, including edge cases (ambiguous, short, sarcastic, typo'd, mixed-language).

cases.input_email: I was charged $49.99 twice on my card this month for the same subscription. Please refund the duplicate charge.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports a duplicate subscription charge and requests a refund.
cases.notes: Clean, unambiguous billing case. Baseline sanity check.

cases.input_email: Every time I try to upload a photo over 5MB the app crashes and closes completely. Happens on both wifi and mobile data.
cases.expected_summary: App crashes when uploading photos larger than 5MB, regardless of network type.

cases.input_email: I try to log in and it says my account has been suspended. I have no idea why, I haven't done anything wrong.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's account is suspended and they don't know why.

cases.input_email: Hey, quick question — do you guys have an iOS app or is it web only?
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether an iOS app exists.
cases.notes: Pre-sales/info question, no issue to resolve.

cases.input_email: I can't access my paid features even though I definitely paid last week.
cases.expected_summary: Customer paid but can't access the paid features they purchased.
cases.notes: Could be account (access) or billing (payment). Labeled billing since root cause is payment processing.

cases.input_email: app broken. fix pls.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports the app is broken without further detail.

cases.input_email: Oh great, another month, another mystery charge I definitely didn't agree to. Love that for me.
cases.expected_summary: Customer sarcastically complains about an unexpected charge they don't recall agreeing to.

cases.input_email: hii i cant resset my pasword the emial never comes thru pls halp
cases.expected_summary: Customer can't reset their password because the reset email never arrives.
cases.notes: Relabeled from ambiguous root-cause reasoning: email delivery failure is the root cause blocking login, not an account-management issue. Category = what team would fix the root cause, not what the customer is blocked from doing.

cases.input_email: My card on file expired last week and I think that's why my payment failed, but I'm not sure how to update it.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's payment failed likely due to an expired card and they need help updating it.

cases.input_email: I cancelled my subscription last month but you guys billed me again anyway. This needs to be fixed immediately.
cases.expected_summary: Customer was billed after cancelling their subscription and wants it corrected.

cases.input_email: Can you explain why my invoice this month is $12 higher than usual? I didn't change my plan.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants an explanation for an unexpected increase in their invoice amount.

cases.input_email: I want to switch from the monthly plan to the annual plan. Will I get a prorated credit for the time left on my current plan?
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to switch plans and is asking about proration.

cases.input_email: Refund status? Requested one 9 days ago, nothing yet.
cases.expected_summary: Customer is following up on a refund requested 9 days ago that hasn't arrived.

cases.input_email: Is there a student discount available? I'm currently enrolled full-time and would love to save a bit if possible.
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether a student discount is available.
cases.notes: Could be general (pre-sales) or billing (pricing). Labeled billing — good disagreement case.

cases.input_email: why is there a $3.99 charge labeled 'convenience fee' on my receipt, nobody told me about this
cases.expected_summary: Customer is questioning an unexplained convenience fee on their receipt.

cases.input_email: I'd like to downgrade my plan starting next billing cycle, not immediately. How do I schedule that?
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to schedule a plan downgrade for the next billing cycle.

cases.input_email: mera paisa kat gaya but subscription active nahi hua, please check
cases.expected_summary: Customer's payment was deducted but the subscription was not activated.

cases.input_email: You people keep charging me for a plan I never signed up for. This is honestly starting to feel like fraud at this point.
cases.expected_summary: Customer believes they're being charged for a plan they never subscribed to and suspects fraud.

cases.input_email: Do you accept PayPal, or only credit cards? Trying to check out but don't see the option.
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking about accepted payment methods, specifically PayPal.

cases.input_email: $$$ WHY DID YOU CHARGE ME AGAIN I ALREADY PAID !!!
cases.expected_summary: Customer is upset about being charged again after already paying.

cases.input_email: The search bar has stopped returning any results for the last two days, even for terms that definitely exist.
cases.expected_summary: Search functionality has stopped returning results for the past two days.

cases.input_email: getting a 502 error every time I try to load my dashboard since this morning
cases.expected_summary: Customer is getting a 502 error loading their dashboard since this morning.

cases.input_email: Video playback is stuttering badly on Chrome but works fine on Safari. Same wifi, same laptop.
cases.expected_summary: Video playback stutters on Chrome but not Safari, on the same device and network.

cases.input_email: notifications stopped working after the last update, i used to get them instantly now nothing
cases.expected_summary: Notifications stopped working after the most recent app update.

cases.input_email: export to CSV button just spins forever and never downloads anything, tried 3 different files
cases.expected_summary: The CSV export feature spins indefinitely without downloading, across multiple files.
cases.notes: Specific feature failure with reproduction attempts noted.

cases.input_email: not sure if this is a bug or just how it works but the numbers on my report page don't match what's on the export
cases.expected_summary: Customer noticed a data mismatch between the report page and the exported file.

cases.input_email: app keeps logging me out every few minutes, super annoying, happens on both my phone and laptop
cases.expected_summary: The app repeatedly logs the customer out every few minutes on multiple devices.
cases.notes: Could be account (session) or technical (bug). Labeled technical — good disagreement case.

cases.input_email: the site is down for me, keeps timing out, is this a known issue on your end?
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports the site is timing out and asks if it's a known outage.

cases.input_email: site loading soooo slow today literally taking like 30 sec per page wat is going on
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports the site is loading extremely slowly, around 30 seconds per page.

cases.input_email: app crash karta hai jab bhi main settings open karta hoon, please fix
cases.expected_summary: The app crashes whenever the customer tries to open settings.

cases.input_email: dark mode toggle doesn't actually change anything, screen stays white no matter what I click
cases.expected_summary: The dark mode toggle does not change the app's appearance.

cases.input_email: broke. again. third time this week. fix your app.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports the app has broken for the third time this week.

cases.input_email: I forgot which email I used to sign up and now I can't log in. Is there a way to recover it?
cases.expected_summary: Customer forgot the email associated with their account and needs recovery help.

cases.input_email: How do I change my display name? I got married and want to update it to my new last name.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to update their display name to reflect a legal name change.

cases.input_email: someone else logged into my account, I see activity I didn't do, please help me secure it asap
cases.expected_summary: Customer suspects unauthorized access to their account and wants it secured urgently.

cases.input_email: I want to permanently delete my account and all my data. How do I do that?
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to permanently delete their account and associated data.

cases.input_email: two factor authentication isn't sending codes to my phone anymore, I'm locked out
cases.expected_summary: Customer is locked out because two-factor authentication codes aren't being sent to their phone.
cases.notes: Relabeled: 2FA code delivery failure is the root cause, not an account-access setting. Consistent with typo_001 and account_011 — all are delivery/infra bugs that happen to block access.

cases.input_email: can i merge my two accounts into one? I accidentally signed up twice with different emails
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to merge two accidentally created accounts into one.

cases.input_email: meri profile pic change nahi ho rahi, upload karte hi error aa jata hai
cases.expected_summary: Customer's profile picture won't update; an error appears every time they try to upload.
cases.notes: Hinglish. Arguably technical (upload error) vs account (profile mgmt).

cases.input_email: pls remove my number from the account i sold my phone and someone else has it now
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to remove their old phone number from the account after selling the device.

cases.input_email: wait why does it say i have a free trial active, i thought i already used mine last year??
cases.expected_summary: Customer is confused about a free trial appearing active when they believe they already used it.
cases.notes: Could be billing (trial/subscription state) or account (status confusion).

cases.input_email: not receiving ANY emails from you guys anymore, not even the reset ones, checked spam already
cases.expected_summary: Customer isn't receiving any emails, including password reset emails, and has checked spam.
cases.notes: Relabeled: missing emails (including reset emails) is a delivery/infra bug, same root-cause pattern as typo_001 and account_006.

cases.input_email: just checking, does deleting the app also delete my account or is my data still saved somewhere?
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to know whether deleting the app also deletes their account and data.

cases.input_email: cant login. tried everything. nothing works.
cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot log in despite trying multiple troubleshooting steps.
cases.notes: Vague, no specifics on what 'tried everything' means.

cases.input_email: What are your customer support hours? Trying to figure out when I can call in.
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking about customer support hours.

cases.input_email: Do you have an affiliate or referral program? I'd love to recommend this to my audience.
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether an affiliate or referral program exists.

cases.input_email: Just wanted to say the new update looks great, really enjoying the redesign!
cases.expected_summary: Customer is giving positive feedback about the recent redesign.

cases.input_email: Is this platform GDPR compliant? Need to confirm for my company's procurement review.
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking about GDPR compliance for a procurement review.

cases.input_email: do u have api docs somewhere? cant find them on the site
cases.expected_summary: Customer is looking for API documentation and can't find it on the site.

cases.input_email: kya aap log Hindi support bhi dete ho?
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether Hindi-language support is available.
cases.notes: Fully in Hinglish. Tests non-English handling.

cases.input_email: just curious, how many users does this platform have? saw a stat somewhere but wasn't sure if current
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking about the platform's current user count.

cases.input_email: thx for the quick help earlier, appreciate it!! no further issue just wanted to say thanks
cases.expected_summary: Customer is expressing thanks for previous help, with no open issue.
Customer sent an email with no discernible content or request.
cases.notes: Degenerate/empty-ish input. Flag if model hallucinates a specific issue.

cases.input_email: loved the podcast episode you guys did about the product roadmap, when's the next one coming out?
cases.expected_summary: Customer enjoyed the company's podcast episode and is asking when the next one releases.
cases.notes: Off-topic-adjacent, brand engagement rather than product issue.
